address: 10243 Saratoga Springs Rd, Upper Lake, CA 95485
geo_notes: Nominatim could not geocode the address. OSM has a 'Saratoga Springs Retreat Center' node (leisure=resort, addr 10243 Saratoga Springs Road) at 39.1748543,-122.9808979; Wikipedia 'Saratoga Springs, California' gives 39.17528,-122.98083; US Census geocoder gives 39.1762,-122.9826. All agree within ~200 m. Location is ~4 mi west of Upper Lake off Hwy 20 at the end of Saratoga Springs Rd (Lake County) — NOT the town of Saratoga in Santa Clara County.

notes: Official site saratogasprings.com redirects to /vintage/ — a 2020-era static site ('last updated July 11, 2020') whose photos are almost all 200-600 px wide; the only large official image is the newsletter lodge photo used as 01. No Heart Lodge, pool or labyrinth photos at usable resolution anywhere official. Two CC BY-SA photos hosted on English Wikipedia (not Commons) were used, plus one 745 px travel-site image that is a larger copy of the site's own banner. Yelp has 16 user photos (bedroom/picnic-table snapshots) — not used. The Hexenfest festival (Oct 2025) lists the center as its venue, so it is still operating. Site text: exclusive use for groups of 25+, 2-10 night stays, 260 acres.
